title: The True Enemy
summary: As Nihilux falls, his dying breath reveals the terrifying truth: the Void Primordial is not an external demon, but the dormant shadow sleeping inside the Sovereign Bloodline itself.

panels.shot: the supernova core detonating in blinding white and violet starlight
panels.action: A sphere of pure white and royal violet light envelopes the entire boulevard, blinding all cameras and eyes.
panels.prose_en: A sphere of pure white and royal violet light envelopes the entire boulevard, blinding all cameras and eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Shuddh safed aur shahi baingani roshni ka ek gola poore buleward ko dhank deta hai, jisse sabhi camere aur aankhen andhi ho jaati han.

panels.shot: the explosion channeled harmlessly into the upper stratosphere by the domain
panels.action: Ha-Jun's Sovereign Domain funnels the cataclysmic energy into a clean column of aurora borealis into space.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's Sovereign Domain funnels the cataclysmic energy into a clean column of aurora borealis into space.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka Sovereign domain pralayankari urja ko aurora boralis ke ek swachh stambh mein antriksh mein bhejta hai.

panels.shot: smoke clears revealing emperor nihilux pinned to the shattered asphalt
panels.action: Nihilux lies broken on the ground, his four arms shattered, chest core reduced to sputtering green embers.
panels.prose_en: Nihilux lies broken on the ground, his four arms shattered, chest core reduced to sputtering green embers.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax zameen par toota hua pada hai, uski char bhujaen chaknachur ho gai han, chhati ka core hare angaare ugalte hue kam ho gaya hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun standing over the dying void emperor
panels.action: Ha-Jun lowers his blade; Tae-Jun stands beside him with his bronze sword, both looking down with solemn victory.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: It's over, Nihilux. The Three Thrones have fallen.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lowers his blade; Tae-Jun stands beside him with his bronze sword, both looking down with solemn victory.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apna blade neeche kar liya; Tae-Jun apni kansya talwar ke saath uske bagal mein khada hai, donon gambhir jeet ke saath neeche dekh rahe han.

panels.shot: nihilux laughing with rattling, bloody amusement through his broken helm
panels.action: Nihilux wheezes, dark fluid bubbling from his mouth, chuckling with bone-chilling mockery.

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: Fallen? Heh... Hehehe... You foolish mortal boy...

panels.prose_en: Nihilux wheezes, dark fluid bubbling from his mouth, chuckling with bone-chilling mockery.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax gharghrahat karta hai, uske muh se gahre taral padarth ke bulbule nikalte han, wah haddiyon ko thanda kar dene wale uphaas ke saath hansta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes narrowing: 'what are you laughing at?'
panels.action: Ha-Jun's jaw tightens: 'Why are you laughing?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumhara armada destroy ho chuka hai. Why are you laughing?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's jaw tightens: 'Why are you laughing?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka jabda kada ho gaya: 'tum kyon hans rahe ho?'

panels.shot: nihilux revealing the cosmic secret of the sovereign bloodline
panels.action: Nihilux: 'You think the Void was an invader from outer space? The Void was born from the First Sovereign himself!'

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: Asmodaius did not fight the Void. He created it when he tried to become God!

panels.prose_en: Nihilux: 'You think the Void was an invader from outer space? The Void was born from the First Sovereign himself!'.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax: 'aapko lagta hai ki shunya bahari antriksh se aaya aakramankaari tha? shunya ka janm swayam pratham samprabhu se hua tha!'.

panels.shot: kuro gasping as an ancient locked memory suddenly unlocks in his skull
panels.action: Kuro's ruby eyes widen in petrified horror as the final locked partition of his 5,000-year memory snaps open.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: No... It can't be... Asmodaius... What did you do?!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's ruby eyes widen in petrified horror as the final locked partition of his 5,000-year memory snaps open.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki ruby aankhen bhaybhit bhay se chaudi ho gain, kyonki uski 5,000 saal ki smriti ka antim band vibhajan khul gaya.

panels.shot: cosmic flashback shard: asmodaius splitting his soul into light and dark
panels.action: Ancient memory: First Sovereign Asmodaius standing in the cosmic forge, tearing his own soul into two halves.

dialogue.text: The Light became the Ten Relics. The Dark became the Void Primordial.

panels.prose_en: Ancient memory: First Sovereign Asmodaius standing in the cosmic forge, tearing his own soul into two halves.
panels.prose_hi: Prachin smriti: pehla samprabhu esmodius brahmandiya gadh mein khada tha, apni aatma ko do hisson mein vibhajit kar raha tha.

panels.shot: nihilux smiling with malicious triumph: 'the true enemy is inside you!'
panels.action: Nihilux: 'The moment your bloodline reaches 100%, the Dark Half awakens inside your mind! You will become the Destroyer!'

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: When you transcend to 100%, you won't be a hero. You will be the Primordial Void yourself!

panels.prose_en: Nihilux: 'The moment your bloodline reaches 100%, the Dark Half awakens inside your mind! You will become the Destroyer!'.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax: 'jis kshan aapki raktarekha 100% tak pahunchti hai, aapke dimag ke andar dark half jaag jata hai! tum vidhvansak ban jaoge!'

panels.shot: nihilux crumbling into gray ash with a final mocking hiss
panels.action: With a final hateful laugh, Nihilux's body disintegrates into gray dust, carried away by the cold Seoul wind.
panels.prose_en: With a final hateful laugh, Nihilux's body disintegrates into gray dust, carried away by the cold Seoul wind.
panels.prose_hi: Antim ghrinit hansi ke sath, nihilax ka shareer seoul ki thandi hawa dwara udaakar bhure rang ki dhul mein vighatit ho jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun staring at his trembling hands in profound, existential shock
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down at his palms; black and purple veins pulse beneath his pale skin in chaotic rhythm.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: The monster... is inside me? Mere apne bloodline mein?!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks down at his palms; black and purple veins pulse beneath his pale skin in chaotic rhythm.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun neeche apni hatheliyon ki or dekhta hai; kali aur baingani nasen uski pili tvacha ke neeche arajak lay mein spandit hoti han.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping up placing both hands on ha-jun trembling shoulders
panels.action: Tae-Jun grips Ha-Jun's shoulders firmly: 'Ha-Jun! Look at me! Don't listen to his dying poison!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun! Meri taraf dekho! You are not a monster!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun grips Ha-Jun's shoulders firmly: 'Ha-Jun! Look at me! Don't listen to his dying poison!'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne Ha-Jun ke kandhon ko majbuti se pakad liya: 'Ha-Jun! meri taraf dekho! uske marte zahar ko mat suno!'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up with tears of terror in his eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun whispers: 'What if he's right, Hyung? What if my 100% synchronization awakens the entity that killed our parents?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar main monster ban gaya... Agar maine Earth ko destroy kar diya... Toh?!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun whispers: 'What if he's right, Hyung? What if my 100% synchronization awakens the entity that killed our parents?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun fusfusata hai: 'kya hoga agar wah sahi hai, hung? kya hoga yadi mera 100% sinkronization us ikai ko jagrit kar de jisne hamare mata-pita ko maar dala?'

panels.shot: tae-jun looking into ha-jun eyes with unshakeable conviction and warmth
panels.action: Tae-Jun smiles with infinite tenderness: 'Then I will be your shield. And if you fall, I will bring you back. Always.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Main hamesha tumhare saath hoon. Chahe tum insaan bano ya shaitan.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun smiles with infinite tenderness: 'Then I will be your shield. And if you fall, I will bring you back. Always.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun aseem komalta ke saath muskurate han: 'tab main tumhari dhal banunga. aur yadi tum giroge to main tumhe wapas le aaunga. hamesha.'.

panels.shot: kuro fluttering down landing on ha-jun head ruffling feathers
panels.action: Kuro sits on Ha-Jun's messy hair: 'Besides, Asmodaius was an arrogant idiot. You are ten times the man he ever was.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Asmodaius couldn't conquer his own dark half. But you have something he never had: love.

panels.prose_en: Kuro sits on Ha-Jun's messy hair: 'Besides, Asmodaius was an arrogant idiot. You are ten times the man he ever was.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro Ha-Jun ke gande baalon par baithta hai: 'iske alava, esmodius ek ahankari bewakoof tha. aap usse das guna adhik aadmi hain jo wah kabhi tha.'

panels.shot: min-jae running up with two cans of soda grinning proudly
panels.action: Min-Jae jogs up with two cold cans of grape soda, handing one to Ha-Jun: 'For the champ who just saved the continent.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Drink up, Ha-Jun. You look like you need sugar.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae jogs up with two cold cans of grape soda, handing one to Ha-Jun: 'For the champ who just saved the continent.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je angoor soda ke do thande dibbe lekar daudte han, aur ek Ha-Jun ko saunpte hue kahte han: 'us vijeta ke liye jisne abhi-abhi mahadweep ko bachaya hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun taking the soda can feeling the cold aluminum against his fingers
panels.action: Ha-Jun pops the tab; the simple, cold, sweet fizzy drink brings him instantly back to reality and humanity.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Thanks, Min-Jae. You're the best.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun pops the tab; the simple, cold, sweet fizzy drink brings him instantly back to reality and humanity.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun tab pop karta hai; saral, thanda, meetha fizi pey use turant vastavikta aur manavta mein wapas lata hai.

panels.shot: the allied army and citizens gathering around them in warm applause
panels.action: Thousands of human hunters, students, and demon legionnaires surround the trio, applauding with quiet reverence.
panels.prose_en: Thousands of human hunters, students, and demon legionnaires surround the trio, applauding with quiet reverence.
panels.prose_hi: Hajaron manav shikari, chhatra aur rakshas senapati shant shraddha ke saath taliyan bajate hue, tikdi ko gher lete han.

panels.shot: sudden dark tremor shaking the ground beneath gwanghwamun square
panels.action: A deep, subsonic rumble vibrates through the granite pavers; the ground temperature drops forty degrees in a second.
panels.prose_en: A deep, subsonic rumble vibrates through the granite pavers; the ground temperature drops forty degrees in a second.
panels.prose_hi: Granit pavers ke madhyam se ek gahri, subsonic gadgdahat kampan karti hai; zameen ka taapmaan ek second mein chalis degree gir jata hai.

panels.shot: the sky tearing open in a colossal black vortex directly overhead
panels.action: Right above the center of Seoul, a pitch-black interdimensional maelstrom opens—the Prime Gate to the Nether Root.
panels.prose_en: Right above the center of Seoul, a pitch-black interdimensional maelstrom opens—the Prime Gate to the Nether Root.
panels.prose_hi: Siyol ke kendra ke theek upar, ek gehra kala antaayami bhanwar khulta hai - nedar root ka pramukh dwar.

panels.shot: from the vortex: a voice identical to ha-jun own voice echoing
panels.action: From the dark maelstrom echoes a dark, mocking voice that sounds exactly like Ha-Jun Kang: 'Come inside, Little Vessel.'

dialogue.speaker: dark_voice
dialogue.text: Come into the dark, Ha-Jun. Let us complete our bloodline.

panels.prose_en: From the dark maelstrom echoes a dark, mocking voice that sounds exactly like Ha-Jun Kang: 'Come inside, Little Vessel.'.
panels.prose_hi: Andhere bhanwar se ek andheri, mazakiya awaaz goonjati hai jo bilkul Ha-Jun kang ki tarah lagti hai: 'ander aao, chhote jahaj.'

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up into the vortex recognizing his own tone
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks up; his irises reflect the spinning black void, realizing his ultimate trial has arrived.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh aawaz... It sounds just like me.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks up; his irises reflect the spinning black void, realizing his ultimate trial has arrived.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun upar dekhta hai; uski aankhon ki putli ghumti hui kali shoonyata ko pratibimbit karti hai, jisse yah ehsaas hota hai ki uska antim parikshan aa gaya hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun gripping his claymore: 'i'm coming with you!'
panels.action: Tae-Jun steps forward: 'I'm entering the gate with you! You aren't facing this alone!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Main tumhare saath chalunga!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun steps forward: 'I'm entering the gate with you! You aren't facing this alone!'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun aage badhta hai: 'main aapke saath gate mein pravesh kar raha hun! aap akele iska samna nahin kar rahe han!'

panels.shot: ha-jun gently raising a golden barrier stopping tae-jun
panels.action: Ha-Jun raises a soft golden barrier: 'No, Hyung. This is my mindscape trial. If you enter, the dark entity will consume you.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Nahi, Tae-Jun. Yeh mere andar ki jung hai. You must protect Earth while I am inside.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun raises a soft golden barrier: 'No, Hyung. This is my mindscape trial. If you enter, the dark entity will consume you.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek naram sunhara avrodh uthata hai: 'nahin, hung. yah mera mindscap parikshan hai. yadi aap pravesh karte han, to andhkarmay ikai aapko bhasm kar degi.'

panels.shot: tae-jun looking at ha-jun with fierce pride and tears in his eyes
panels.action: Tae-Jun presses his palm against the golden barrier, smiling with tears: 'Promise me you'll come back, Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Wapas aane ka vaada karo.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun presses his palm against the golden barrier, smiling with tears: 'Promise me you'll come back, Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apni hatheli ko sunhare avrodh ke khilaf dabata hai, aur aansuon ke saath muskurata hai: 'mujse vaada karo tum wapas aaoge, Ha-Jun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling with radiant, heroic certainty
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles back: 'I promise. I will conquer the darkness and come home.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Vaada raha. Main wapas aaunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles back: 'I promise. I will conquer the darkness and come home.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun muskurata hai: 'main vaada karta hun. main andhere par vijay paa loonga aur ghar aa jaunga.'

panels.shot: kuro perching on ha-jun shoulder: 'i'm your familiar. wherever you go, i go.'
panels.action: Kuro digs his talons into Ha-Jun's coat: 'The covenant binds us across life and death. You can't get rid of me that easily.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: We face the Abyss together.

panels.prose_en: Kuro digs his talons into Ha-Jun's coat: 'The covenant binds us across life and death. You can't get rid of me that easily.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne Ha-Jun ke coat mein apne panje gada die: 'vacha hamen jeevan aur mrityu ke paar bandhti hai. tum mujhse itni aasani se chhutkara nahin paa sakte.'

panels.shot: ha-jun ascending vertically into the dark maelstrom
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Kuro rise into the sky, six radiant wings of starlight carrying them into the pitch-black center of the portal.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Kuro rise into the sky, six radiant wings of starlight carrying them into the pitch-black center of the portal.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aur Kuro aakash mein uthte han, taron ki roshni ke chhah ujjwal pankh unhen portal ke gahre kale kendra mein le jaate han.

panels.shot: the dark vortex closing behind ha-jun as arc 9 concludes cliffhanger
panels.action: The dimensional gate snaps shut behind him; the final arc has begun!

dialogue.text: ARC 9: THE WAR OF SOVEREIGNS — CONCLUDED. NEXT: ARC 10 — THE LAST BLOOD.

panels.prose_en: The dimensional gate snaps shut behind him; the final arc has begun!.
panels.prose_hi: Aayami gate snap uske peeche band ho gaya; antim charan shuru ho gaya hai!
